name: Neem Powder 100gm- For Healthy Blood Sugar
original_description:
Falcon Herbs – Pure Neem Powder (100g)
Traditional Ayurvedic Herb for Daily Rituals

Rooted in ancient wisdom, Neem Powder is derived from the leaves of the revered Azadirachta indica tree — a cornerstone of Ayurvedic tradition for centuries. Sourced from organically grown neem leaves and stone-ground into a fine, unadulterated powder, this product honors the heritage of natural living.

In classical Ayurvedic texts, neem is recognized for its cooling, cleansing, and balancing properties. It has long been used as part of daily wellness routines to support the body’s natural rhythms and internal harmony. Its distinct bitter taste is considered a key quality in traditional formulations aimed at promoting inner balance.

Perfect for those who follow Ayurvedic principles, this powder can be incorporated into herbal infusions, water-based elixirs, or culinary preparations as part of a mindful lifestyle.

How to Use:
Take 3 grams (approx. 1 tsp) once or twice daily, mixed with warm water or as traditionally advised by your wellness practitioner.

Quality Assurance:
- 100% Pure Neem Leaf Powder
- No Additives, Fillers, or Preservatives
- Sun-Dried & Stone-Ground
- Vegan, Gluten-Free, Non-GMO

Store in a cool, dry place. Keep out of reach of children.

This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any condition. It is offered as a traditional herbal ingredient for cultural and wellness practices.
